qualification: analytical profile vectors, not physical S3 capture

derivation.independent_state: D[n] = sum(y[k]-x[k-1]); A[n] = sum(D[k]); zero initial errors imply D[n]=e[n]-e[n-1], A[n]=e[n]
derivation.output_bit: 1 iff y[n]=+128; pulse interval is APB/(prescale_field+1)
derivation.reset: A=D=0, delayed input seeded from density, output initially low
derivation.density_change: A=D=0, delayed input seeded from new density; previous output holds until next tick
derivation.divider_source_gate: preserve errors and fractional cycle progress
derivation.boundedness: A repeated integer (D,A) certifies the constant-input reachable orbit; no repeat only certifies a finite prefix, not boundedness or silicon width

analytical_vectors.reason: After m initial highs D=m,A=m(m+1)/2; m(m+3)/2<=127 admits m=14, not m=15
Initial lows yield D=-m,A=-m(m+1)/2; threshold first crosses at m=15
